text: Employee is servicing the conveyor with power connected and no lock or tag applied.
Operator's hand can reach the unguarded point of operation on the running press.
Worker is exposed to an unprotected roof edge approximately 18 feet above the lower level with no guardrail or personal fall arrest system.
Extension cord has exposed copper conductors and remains energized in the work area.
A worker is dry-cutting concrete block with a gas-powered masonry saw with no water suppression or dust collection, generating a visible dust cloud in his breathing zone.
The east emergency exit door in the occupied warehouse is chained shut during the shift with 20 employees working.
A 5-gallon container of solvent in the paint shop has no label identifying its contents or hazards.
Two laborers are working in a 7-foot deep trench in clay soil with no trench box, sloping, or shoring.
The guard on the conveyor tail pulley at the surface mine is missing, exposing miners to the moving parts.
Employees in the grinding area are exposed to a measured 92 dBA 8-hour TWA with no hearing conservation program.
At the surface mine, a miner is servicing the crusher drive with power connected and no lock or tag applied.

Guardrails on the mezzanine platform are properly secured and no deficiencies were observed there. Separately, a portable generator power cord has exposed conductors and damaged insulation near a wet floor area. A worker was performing maintenance on the stamping press without lockout applied and stored energy had not been released.
Maintenance is being performed on the packaging line.
A trench about 5 feet deep is open near the loading dock.
There is an extension cord on the floor of the shop.
Employees report that the mixing room is loud.
Guard status on the press could not be confirmed during the walkthrough.
Worker is exposed to an unprotected roof edge approximately 18 feet above the lower level with no guardrail or personal fall arrest system.
A crane is lifting a steel beam and two workers are standing under the suspended load.
